summary: The argument proves both stated bounds for arbitrary group incidence and arbitrary permitted one-step points. The smallest parameter case and the residual cases with singleton or extinct groups, no surviving neutral coordinates, and lower-dimensional sections cause no exception. The affine transfer inequalities retain the exact fourth-power mass factor; both accepted facts are applied with matching supports, fields, normalizations, and extra-zero embeddings. The residual inverse-size estimate, favored-section mass bound, termination argument, constants, and exact double-point description of the canonical convex-lattice support are valid.
